ns2:section.sectionText: Offered only for 2 GR hours in Summer 2008. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Begins with a 6/9 evening class; continues 6/13-15 with participation in the 4th Annual Community as Intellectual Space (CIS) symposium, "Aesthetics as Resistance: The Act of Community Building." [590 CIO students attending the CIS symposium are entitled to a reduced registration fee of $60, which includes some meals.] Class meetings: Mon., 6/9 (6-9pm); Fri., 6/13 (2-9pm); Sat., 6/14 (8am-7pm); Sun., 6/15 (9-3pm). Includes readings, initial class session, CIS participation, structured experiential learning & final paper (due 6/27) that describes and reflects on in- and out-of-class activities. Location: Puerto Rican Cultural Center, 2700-2704 West Haddon St., Chicago.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
